about.title: Gardena Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Gardena's traffic runs through a tight grid of major corridors — Redondo Beach Boulevard, Western Avenue, Normandie Avenue, and Rosecrans Avenue — where crash reports tend to cluster around Friday afternoon rush hour. Los Angeles County crash data shows these intersections see a steady share of injury collisions each year, and even a low-speed crash can leave someone dealing with medical bills, missed work, and an insurance adjuster looking for a quick, low statement. We handle personal injury claims directly and can review your situation for free. Whether your crash happened at a signal on Western Avenue or in a parking lot off Rosecrans, having someone who understands local roads and how insurers evaluate these claims can make the process less confusing from the start.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, though claims against a government entity can require notice in as little as six months. Speaking with an attorney early helps make sure important deadlines aren't missed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cut Your Recovery
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning your compensation can be reduced by the percentage of fault assigned to you, even if that's decided later by an insurer. An attorney can help make sure fault isn't overstated against you based on an early recorded statement.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. Understanding what that means for your specific injuries is easier with guidance from someone who reviews these claims regularly.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers often use these statements to look for ways to reduce or dispute a claim. Our team can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my crash happened at one of Gardena's busier intersections, like Western and Redondo Beach Boulevard?
items.answer: Crashes at high-traffic corridors like Western Avenue, Redondo Beach Boulevard, Normandie Avenue, or Rosecrans Avenue often involve multiple vehicles and conflicting accounts of what happened. Preserving evidence quickly — photos, witness contacts, and traffic camera footage if available — matters, and we can help guide that process.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney?
items.answer: Our free consultation costs nothing, and we typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery. You can find out where you stand without any upfront financial commitment.
